sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and riding an impressive run of form (W-D-W-W-W from their last five), host Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October. Alsager arrive in poor shape, bottom of the league with just 4 points from 10 matches and a run of five consecutive losses before a solitary win, making them significant underdogs in this fixture.
divisionWide: Stafford Town, second place with 20 points, travel to Dawley Town in a match that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach if they secure victory. AFC Bridgnorth (third, 19 points) host Eccleshall (fifth, 18 points) in a direct battle between two strong sides, though Bridgnorth's recent loss suggests some vulnerability. Wolverhampton Casuals, joint third on 19 points, welcome Wednesfield Community at home as they look to maintain their title credentials. Bilston Town (sixth, 17 points) travel to Foley Meir (13th, 11 points) in a clash between mid-table sides. Barnton (seventh, 15 points) host Shawbury United (15th, 10 points), with Shawbury's alarming five-game losing streak making them particularly vulnerable. New Mills (eighth, 14 points) visit Market Drayton Town (tenth, 12 points) in a fixture between struggling teams. Crewe (16th, 9 points) host Allscott Heath (11th, 11 points) as they battle relegation form. Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th, 7 points) travel to face Telford Town (18th, 6 points) in a basement clash. Finally, Brereton Social (14th, 11 points) are at home to Widnes Town (20th, 2 points), the division's bottom side with just two points from seven games and no wins to date.
